name: Cicatrix Blue
source:
You're stuck on a train for who-knows-how-long with your ex-friends from high school. You're all still very bitter about what happened, and it seems like fate really wanted you to suffer by putting you in this situation with them, of all people. Do your best to survive alongside them, as each person brings challenges from your past into the present.

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/cicatrix-blue]itch.io[/url]]
